message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Growth Rate", "construction": "Annual percentage change in inventory (Compustat item INVQ) over the past fiscal year, divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "Rapid inventory accumulation may signal over-optimism or demand overestimation, while slow or negative growth may indicate prudent management or strong sales.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt to Total Assets", "construction": "Ratio of short-term debt (Compustat item DLCQ) to total assets (Compustat item ATQ) at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Firms with higher short-term leverage may face refinancing risk and financial distress, while lower ratios indicate more stable capital structures.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Change in R&D expense (Compustat item XRDQ) as a percentage of sales (Compustat item SALEQ) from previous to current fiscal year.", "rationale": "Increasing R&D intensity may signal innovation and future growth opportunities not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Cash Flow to Market Equity", "construction": "Operating cash flow (Compustat item OANCFY) divided by market capitalization at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "High cash flow relative to market value may indicate undervaluation or strong fundamentals.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Dummy", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if a firm initiates a regular cash dividend in the past year, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend initiations may signal management confidence in future earnings and financial stability.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with a value of 1"}, {"name": "Net Insider Buying", "construction": "Net number of shares purchased by insiders (Form 4 filings) over the past 12 months, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insider purchases may reflect private information about undervaluation or positive prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Earnings Announcement Drift", "construction": "Cumulative abnormal return from 2 days before to 2 days after the most recent quarterly earnings announcement.", "rationale": "Stocks with strong post-announcement drift may reflect underreaction to news, predicting further returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Sales Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly sales growth rates (Compustat item SALEQ) over the past 8 quarters.", "rationale": "Lower sales volatility may indicate more predictable business models and lower risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Share Repurchase Yield", "construction": "Net shares repurchased (reduction in shares outstanding from Compustat item CSHOQ) over the past year, divided by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Firms buying back shares may signal undervaluation or excess cash flow.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Annual percentage change in number of employees (Compustat item EMP) over the past fiscal year.", "rationale": "Rapid employee growth may signal expansion and optimism, but could also indicate overextension.", "higher_returns_for": "moderate values of the measure"}]}
